name: Isparta

queries.query: Isparta cadastral parcel map official TKGM parcel query Isparta municipality GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official TKGM Parsel Sorgu viewer, the official TKGM API host used by that viewer, and the official Isparta municipal Kent Rehberi route.

queries.query: Isparta kadastro parsel sorgu resmi harita Isparta Belediyesi Kent Rehberi
queries.result: Türkçe first-party discovery confirmed TKGM Parsel Sorgu as the official public parcel viewer and Isparta Belediyesi Kent Rehberi as the municipal map route. The TKGM public API returned a safe parcel geometry at the exact WUP point; the municipal route timed out in bounded inspection.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and Turkish discovery, current TKGM viewer JavaScript/config inspection, and bounded anonymous official API requests
sourceReview: TKGM is the national cadastral custodian and its official public Parsel Sorgu viewer/API returned a GeoJSON parcel feature for Isparta Merkez at the exact queue point. Isparta Belediyesi also documents its local Kent Rehberi, but that route was not anonymously available during this attempt. This packet records source evidence only and is not source integration/admission.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official TKGM viewer landing page loaded. It referenced main.js?v=76.3 and RequireJS application assets.
Current public JavaScript loaded and referenced util/constants.
Current viewer configuration exposed the public API base https://cbsapi.tkgm.gov.tr/megsiswebapi.v3.1/api/ and the parcel tile host. No login or private token was used.
Anonymous FeatureCollection returned; Isparta was present with native administrative id 54.
Anonymous administrative FeatureCollection returned; Merkez was present with native district id 486.
Anonymous administrative FeatureCollection returned 45 neighborhoods; Pirimehmet was present with native neighborhood id 140151.

Exact WUP point returned one GeoJSON Polygon. The response identified Isparta / Merkez / Pirimehmet / ada 721 / parsel 310, with safe descriptive fields including area, land-use type, map sheet and administrative IDs.

Official municipal Kent Rehberi route did not return an anonymous response in the bounded request. No retry bypass, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare handling, credentials, or TLS bypass was attempted; this is not evidence of municipal coverage absence.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: The current TKGM viewer constants identified the API base and public parcel route. The parcel response was GeoJSON Feature with Polygon geometry.
schemaAndCrs.geometryTransport: GeoJSON Feature / Polygon; coordinates are in [longitude, latitude] order.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No explicit CRS member was present in the bounded Feature response; coordinates are consistent with WGS 84 geographic longitude/latitude and are retained unchanged.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No single opaque parcel ID was exposed in the returned safe feature. Stable composite identity is ilId/ilceId/mahalleId/adaNo/parselNo = 54/486/140151/721/310.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Constructed only from the returned TKGM administrative IDs and ada/parsel fields; not an internal row number.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID or documented composite native identity
source field names in metadata only

qualification.reason: A real official anonymous parcel response and unchanged safe polygon were obtained, but independent serial adapter qualification is still required before runtime admission.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [37.7699601132631,30.5514856827015] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
One exact-point parcel hit does not establish citywide cadastral coverage or completeness.
Only one full parcel polygon is retained; no raw source attribute set is retained in GeoJSON properties.
The GeoJSON response did not declare an explicit CRS member; coordinate order and likely WGS 84 interpretation are documented as evidence, not asserted as a source declaration.
The municipal Kent Rehberi timeout is an unavailable-route observation only, not evidence of absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: TKGM public API availability, parcel coverage outside the sampled location, update cadence, and the absence of an opaque parcel key remain unverified. The composite identity is likely stable because it uses returned administrative IDs plus ada/parsel numbers, but its long-term immutability was not independently documented.
